candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (ReadTimeout, transport error); order's own call to payment also times out at ~2s, so payment-side latency propagates up to checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry; whether payment is slow or unreachable is unconfirmed. Inventory/redis calls succeed fast.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 driven by a transport ReadTimeout on gateway->order, and order->payment also ReadTimeout at ~2s while inventory/redis succeed. Consistent 2s durations across requests point to downstream latency at payment. Payment-side evidence is absent, so confidence is moderate.
